_doc: SIMCODE v2 models (the shipped models; read through simcode.config.model_set(name), which also takes the path of a model folder with a model.json). File names are relative to the models directory. One model = pass-1 detector + head, pass-2 detector + head (p2L), their solve calibrations and the selection-aware sigma rescale. cal_sim / p2_cal_sim = simulation sigma calibrations (no real-data mismatch multiplier); cal_real / p2_cal_real = the ones used on real movies; sig_u = sigma rescale per pass (strict.build_table sig_u), pass 1 then pass 2. All models are PSF-matched: trained on one averaged in-situ PSF (psf).

_production._doc: How the paper's SIMCODE v2 tables are made: python -m simcode.run --dataset <name> (= --movie, --calib, --model of the entry, the calibration kind below (cal_real), and the run.py defaults: pass 2, the model's sig_u rescale, the subset files of the selections, sigma_max 12 nm). Movies are relative to the data root.
_production._selection_doc: main selection (user decision 2026-11-13): rows with a per-tile rank (p >= 0.63, inside the crop) and calibrated max(sigma_x, sigma_y) <= 12 nm (simcode.strict.select(table), SIGMA_MAX_NM; subset file locs_p2_sig12.npz). Until 2026-11-13 it was the per-tile rule u <= 0.45 ('u045', rule 'u', still written as locs_p2_u045.npz). Study: analysis/selection_global, out/selection_global.

20nM_2._doc: no PSF-matched model was trained for this movie; a model must be chosen if it enters the paper

m1809._doc: PSF-matched model for the 1809/2 movie (averaged 1809/2 in-situ PSF; adopted 2026-11-11; production out/paper2/1809_2/v2_matched); also the model of the realistic-PSF paper simulations | 2026-11-14: retrained with the 3D head (z output; out/z3d), files in m1809/; the previous 2D model is the folder archive_2d/m1809/ (not referenced by any config)
m1809.head: m1809/hd_m1809.pt

m25._doc: PSF-matched model for the 2.5 nM / 2 movie (averaged 2.5 nM in-situ PSF; production out/paper2/2.5nM_2/v2_matched) | 2026-11-14: retrained with the 3D head (z output; out/z3d), files in m25/; the previous 2D model is the folder archive_2d/m25/ (not referenced by any config)
m25.head: m25/hd_m25.pt

g13._doc: PSF-matched model for the Gaussian sigma 1.3 px PSF (preprint-condition simulations; m1809 recipe + --dens 0.0005,0.06, --tau 3,80; 2026-11-12)
g13.head: hd_g13.pt

m1809g._doc: 1809_2 PSF with the GENERIC pass 2 (2026-11-13, g2ss: pattern draw with arbitrary pitch / angles / per-frame phases / order / depth / power, standard-draw share 0.5; out/p2generic). Pass 1 = m1809. Within 1-2 % of m1809 pass 2 on SIMCODE patterns; beats pass 1 on other patterns (nanoruler, 4-step, random phases). Use for setups other than the DMD-SIMFLUX one. Real-data multiplier of p2_cal_real copied from m1809, not re-measured.
m1809g.head: hd_m1809.pt
